$E = (ab-0)(b\cdot 0-a^2)(0\cdot a-b^2) = (ab)(-a^2)(-b^2) = a^3 b^3$.

$E = (a^2-c^2) a^2 (c-a)^2 = -(a+c) a^2 (a-c)^3$.
